title: Author Correction: A framework to evaluate machine learning crystal stability predictions

extraction.note: pdf_page=1 is a synthetic locator for the single-page HTML excerpt, not a publisher PDF page

blocks.text: In the version of this article initially published, Figs. 1–3, Table 1 and the Supplementary Information presented more models than were present in the accepted version of the article, and which were not discussed in the text. The Supplementary Information has been revised and the figures and table are now updated in the HTML and PDF versions of the article.
